title: SelenEkto Artemis III candidate lunar south-pole regions
source_note: 13 regions announced by NASA on 2022-08-19. Coordinates from M2M-30044 (2025-03-18), Table A2.1-1, p.75.
coordinate_convention_note: Original signed coordinate values are preserved exactly. See per-record longitude_convention before using with an ephemeris provider.

sources.title: NASA Identifies Candidate Regions for Landing Next Americans on Moon
Moon to Mars Lunar Surface Data Book

sites.name: Faustini Rim A

coordinate_source.document: NASA Moon to Mars (M2M) Lunar Surface Data Book

sites.coordinate_quality_note: The data book states that coordinates were generated from PGDA South Pole LOLA DEM files and that the centres of the original polygons are accurate to 5–10 m. These are representative region-centre coordinates, not a selected 100 m-radius landing site.
sites.coordinate_frame: Moon Mean Earth (MOON_ME), consistent with the data-book / PGDA context; confirm exact realization when combining sources
sites.longitude_convention: Signed longitude as printed in M2M-30044 Table A2.1-1. JPL Horizons expects lunar east longitude. Treat signed values as signed east longitude only after confirming the data-book coordinate convention against the chosen reference-frame metadata; do not silently convert for mission-grade calculations.
limitations: Region-centre coordinate is not a precision landing target.
Coordinates alone do not establish local topographic horizon or landing safety.
